title: A morphism from an affine scheme to a separated scheme is affine
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. If $X$ is an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $S$ is separated, i.e. its structure morphism $S\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], then $f$ is an affine morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism].
